name: Nigel Brassgear
description: Owner of Gearcog Manufacturing, the city's largest factory. A ruthless industrialist and secret member of the Cog and Key. His workers fear him, his competitors envy him, and he'll do anything to maintain power.

initial_greeting.text: A detective in my factory? This better be important. I run a business here, not a charity for lazy investigators.

choices.text: What can you tell me about illegal activities here?

steamwright_question.text: That inventor? Good riddance. He was trying to automate everything, put my workers out of jobs. His 'innovations' would have destroyed Gearhaven's economy. Someone did us a favor.

choices.text: Where were you the night he died?

accusation.text: *laughs* Illegal? Everything I do is perfectly legal. I have friends in high places who make sure of it. Now leave before I have security escort you out.

choices.text: I'll be back with a warrant.

denial.text: I said someone did us a favor. I didn't say it was me. I have alibis, lawyers, and political connections. You have nothing.

alibi.text: At the Gilded Gear Club, playing cards with the Mayor and several council members. All night. All verified. Now get out.

threat.text: Good luck with that, Detective. My lawyers will tear it apart. And you'll find yourself reassigned to the worst precinct in Gearhaven.
